main.remarks: An immutable lightweight summary of SAML-specific assertion facts intended for runtime policy evaluation.

property.name: Audiences
property.summary: Audience restrictions carried by the SAML assertion summary.

property.name: AuthenticationContextClassReference
property.summary: SAML authentication context class reference if present.

property.name: AuthenticationTime
property.summary: Authentication instant if the SAML summary provides one; otherwise null.

property.name: InResponseTo
property.summary: Response correlation identifier if the SAML assertion was issued in response to a prior request.

property.name: NameIDFormat
property.summary: SAML NameID format URI if present.

property.name: NotAfter
property.summary: Assertion expiration instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: NotBefore
property.summary: Assertion not-before instant if present; otherwise null.

property.name: SessionNotOnOrAfter
property.summary: Session expiration instant if the SAML assertion provides one; otherwise null.

property.name: SubjectConfirmationMethod
property.summary: SAML subject confirmation method if present.

method.name: Copy
method.summary: Create a copy of the SAML assertion summary.

method.name: HasAudience
method.summary: Determine whether the SAML assertion summary contains an audience restriction.
method.returns: True if the audience is present; otherwise false.

method.name: IsExpiredAt
method.summary: Determine whether the SAML assertion summary would be expired at a specific instant.
method.param: Instant to test against the assertion expiration time.
method.returns: True if the assertion has an expiration time and that time is before the supplied instant; otherwise false.
